description: Constraints from the Kestria profile: the GovKestria design system, the reserved codes for a fictional country, and Kestria's shared platforms and law. Kestria is a fictional country, used for demonstration.

constraints.title: Every page shows the fictional-country notice, in the banner and in the footer

patterns: class="[^"]*\bkg-banner\b[^>]*>(?:\s*<div[^>]*>)?\s*(?:Kestria is a fictional country, used for demonstration\.|Kesträ e kuvelta maro, naitoslo\.)
\bkg-footer\b[\s\S]*?(?:Kestria is a fictional country, used for demonstration\.|Kesträ e kuvelta maro, naitoslo\.)

constraints.fix: Use the ServiceHeader and Footer markup from DESIGN.md. Never remove or shorten the notice: without it a demo can be mistaken for a real government service.

constraints.title: Every page is built on GovKestria: tokens.css then kestria.css, the kg-body and kg-main wrappers, and the skip link
No hard-coded colours in stylesheets: every colour comes from a token
constraints.fix: Use var(--token). If no token fits, add one to tokens.json and tokens.css first.

constraints.title: No hard-coded colours in pages: icons use currentColor
constraints.fix: Draw icons with stroke="currentColor" so they take the text colour.

constraints.title: Every page offers the other language
constraints.source: Digital Government Act 2023, s.14 (profiles/kestria/profile.md, Law and policy)
constraints.fix: Add the language switcher from the ServiceHeader. Every national service must work in Kestrian and English.

constraints.title: Each page is under 100 KB before fonts
constraints.fix: Cut the page down. It has to load on a 2G connection.

constraints.title: Phone numbers, email addresses and links use only Kestria's reserved codes, and money shows as K
constraints.fix: Use +999 numbers, kestria.test addresses and K for money. A real number or domain in a demo can reach a real person.

constraints.title: No home-made sign-in: people sign in with KestriaID
constraints.fix: Send the person to "Sign in with KestriaID" (eSignet, OpenID Connect). A service never sees a password.

constraints.title: The service never asks for an account number, card number or PIN
constraints.fix: Remove the field. GovPay takes payments and the Treasury disbursement service pays people; the service only ever shows a masked account.

constraints.title: No emoji in pages
constraints.fix: Use words, with an inline SVG line icon beside them where an icon helps.
